`git fetch` command.

To get all threads with each `git fetch`, run this command one time:

```bash
git config --add remote.origin.fetch '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'
```

All people who can read the repository can read these refs, also the output of tools. Keep secrets away from the agent, as for all CI jobs. See [Security](security.md#thread-contents-are-vis
